methods.central: Actual PGlite dumpDataDir to disk, close database, new PGlite loadDataDir from saved bytes
methods.product: Actual node:sqlite backup into a separate file, stop host, replace offline DB, remove only its stale WAL/SHM files, reopen
methods.pairing: Await all synthetic writes and worker runs, close HTTP admission before taking the two snapshots
methods.manifest: Physical SHA-256 and logical inventory digests of the paired saved artifacts
methods.admission: Read-only test fixture checks only; no production restore gate is installed

limitations: Two sequential snapshots are consistent only because the isolated writers and HTTP/worker are quiesced; this is not an atomic cross-database backup mechanism.
Two coherent old backups cannot detect later hold/deletion erased from both histories without newer sequence or erasure knowledge retained outside the pair.
The knownLatest comparison is a rehearsal input, not an implemented remote source of deletion knowledge.
No production backup encryption, storage, retention, schedule, remote recovery, actual PostgreSQL/Supabase deployment or live-device proof.
No production automatic restore admission or catch-up is implemented by this test.

runtime.central: PGlite using canonical SYNK-talk migration fixture

artifacts: Physical dump and backup files were created and checked in guarded temporary directories, then removed; only test logs, source hashes and procedure evidence remain
confirmedChecks: Lost acknowledgment and same event retry preserve product receipt, high-water, seen sequence and original introduction archive
Restored temporary hold requires explicit public consent, per-peer reopen and a new acceptance
Restored final tombstone rejects a later active event
Actual damaged central cursor/outbox or product receipts/high-water/seen-sequence are detected
Archive loss changes the actual SQLite backup checksum
Individually valid snapshots from mismatched delivery points are rejected
A newer external sequence watermark rejects coherent older backups before an eventual final deletion; newer deletion knowledge also rejects them

finalPolicySourceRerun.sourceChanges: Service/store now include persistent adult-required DB policy and persistent same-sequence adult conflict protection
finalPolicySourceRerun.scope: Existing five backup/restore checks rerun; adult policy-specific tests remain in the adult subtask
